curriculum: The Dutch-taught, part-time Environmental Sciences BSc totals 180 EC. The 2026–27 guide narrative gives 60 EC foundation, 65 EC restricted choices, 30 EC free electives and a 25 EC graduation phase. Its detailed catalog lists 14 five-credit restricted courses, totaling 70 EC. The timetable footer instead says at least 60 out of 80 EC and allows surplus restricted study in free space. The comparison uses 65 EC from the verified list plus 30 EC of free electives, which closes the degree and exceeds the timetable minimum. It does not fix a set of 13 courses or claim a unique minimum or precise total pool in the face of the differing publications.
progression: The practicum requires 25 foundation credits including evolution and chemistry, with physiology completed earlier or taken alongside it. Mathematics is recommended. Research Approaches in Environmental Sciences requires completion of the 60 EC foundation certificate; 25 later credits are recommended. The graduation project requires the foundation, completed research approaches, at least 40 EC completed or exempted within restricted post-foundation choices, and the academic skills portfolio assessment. The study guide lists advance registration for the practicum and graduation sequence. Both intake rosters show progression through foundations and restricted choices before the graduation phase. The graduation project is a supervised environmental research commission and is required.
